applicabilityBasis.summary: DGLD is a tokenized co-ownership right in allocated physical gold, not a digital asset designed as a payment or settlement instrument with fixed monetary-value redemption. Its issuer terms expressly disclaim a stable-value promise.

genius.notes: DGLD is a tokenized physical-gold co-ownership product. GTSA's terms identify the Swiss issuer and VQF SRO context; no GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization posture applies. The current FAQ permits secondary-market acquisition subject to applicable law and describes MiCA Title II classification. Its former EU/EEA solicitation-restriction claim is no longer supported.
